note: Declared LLM call sites. The shipped app runtime calls no LLM; these are offline tooling plus one batch job whose output reaches the product. Registered into LightTrack via `lt use-cases register`; the gap between this declaration and observed events.name is the coverage report.

use_cases.name: Semantic filter benchmark
use_cases.description: Benchmarks a LOTUS-style sem_filter operator that labels a batch of items match/no-match with a confidence score, to compare against a deterministic baseline.

use_cases.name: Semantic aggregation benchmark
use_cases.description: Benchmarks a sem_agg operator that either aggregates vote counts or narrates known facts into a headline/summary for a voting session.

use_cases.name: Semantic join benchmark
use_cases.description: Benchmarks a sem_join operator that links a noisy candidate name to the correct registry entry (or abstains), scored for positive-accuracy, negative-abstain and fabrication rate.

use_cases.name: Semantic derive benchmark
use_cases.description: Benchmarks a sem_derive operator that derives numeric vote-tally fields (n_votes, acceptance rate, margins, etc.) from raw vote records, compared against ground truth.

use_cases.name: Vote theme classification
use_cases.description: Batch-classifies each roll-call vote into a policy theme and writes the result into the PGlite vote_tag table; this is the one call site whose output reaches the shipped product, since VoteTrack's theme filter reads vote_tag directly.

use_cases.name: Impeccable copy-edit apply agent
use_cases.description: Dev-tool skill that runs a copy-edit batch through the Claude or Codex CLI (env-selectable) to apply live copy edits directly to source files.
